caption: A clear-cut crystal pendant is turned in sunlight, and coloured sparkles dance across the ceiling.

sa.check: A clear-cut crystal pendant is turned in sunlight.
Coloured sparkles dance across the ceiling.
The sparkles disappear when the pendant is put down or the sun goes in.

pc.expect: The sparkles move as the pendant turns and would disappear if it were put down or the sun went in.
pc.fail: They stay put while the pendant turns; or are there with no sun; or the pendant turns in sun with no sparkles.

pc.expect: The sparkles do not move on their own.
pc.fail: They dance with the pendant still; or flicker in steady sun; or drift.
They are all white; or a single colour; or change colour with nothing moving.

pc.expect: The sparkles are many small spots.
pc.fail: They merge into one flood; or are large squares; or a single spot.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or a sparkle becomes solid.
Furniture rearranges; or the ceiling changes; or the pendant changes shape.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
